description: This file provides date and time formatting utilities using dayjs and Intl.DateTimeFormat, including caching mechanisms and support checks for locales.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a locale is supported by Intl.DateTimeFormat, with caching.

methods.name: getFormatter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached Intl.DateTimeFormat instance based on locale and options.

methods.name: buildIntlOptions
methods.description: Builds Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions object from custom options, optionally including month.

methods.name: formatWithDayjs
methods.description: Formats a date using dayjs with locale and options, handling month formatting.

methods.name: getDateForWeekday
methods.description: Calculates a Date object for a given weekday number relative to today.
